Description:
Operations Manager - Maxguard Auto Services / Culture Autohuas

Location: Dubai and Abu Dhabi, UAE

Department: Operations

Reports to: COO

Maxguard is the UAE's paint protection pioneer.

We started in 2005, selling protection in dealer showrooms, training the sales teams and fitting it in the workshops. That B2B (supply and apply) end to end model still runs today and now covers protection, window film, PPF, wraps, styling, accessories and fleet preparation, alongside our own range and our new B2C studio in Dubai.

We have protected over 1M vehicles, with up to 2,000 vehicles a month through dealerships. We are active today in the UAE and Oman, and expanding across the GCC.

Our ambition is to be the most trusted and innovative provider of premium automotive protection solutions in the GCC region, setting global benchmarks in quality, technology and customer satisfaction.

We work to one standard: the same process whether the car arrives at our studio or is prepared at a dealership, with products and methods chosen for extreme heat, UV exposure, sand abrasion and personalisation.

The role:

Maxguard Auto Services is hiring an Operations Manager to run service delivery across our sites in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

You will make sure every site delivers its jobs on time, to our high standards, at the planned hours and material cost. You will own weekly controls, set the standards each site works to, and close the gaps in productivity, quality and cost.

This is a hands-on, multi-site leadership role. You will be on site, in the numbers, and accountable for what gets delivered each week.

What you will own:

1. Delivery and quality

Track every site's jobs, finish times and comebacks. Investigate any comebacks and fix the root cause, not just the symptom.

2. Productivity

Hold technician utilisation to standard. Set standard hours per job for each service with supervisors and keep them documented and enforced.

3. Controls

Run weekly controls without exception: material roll counts, tint labour checked against the bank, and a purchase order before every job. Report controls in the budget KPI sheet every week.

4. People and rotas

Set duty schedules and rotas across sites. Coach and review site supervisors. Keep uniforms and attendance to standard. Support your team in all aspects of their daily routines ensuring employees are well informed and have job satisfaction.

5. Health, safety and site standards

Keep every site safe, clean and organised. Make sure tools and equipment are maintained.

How success is measured:

- Productive hours per technician and efficiencies per month, reviewed weekly

- Comebacks, reviewed weekly

- Weekly controls completed: roll counts, tint labour vs bank, purchase orders

- Jobs done per site vs plan, reviewed weekly

Your authority:

Rotas, job allocation between sites, and standard hours once agreed.

Hiring, overtime above budget, and changes of supplier go to the Strategic Lead for approval.

Who you will work with:

Internal: COO, Strategic Lead, site supervisors, branch manager, Procurement lead on materials, Accountant on controls

External: Suppliers of tools and equipment

Direct reports: Site Supervisors (Culture and Abu Dhabi), Supervisor / Driver (Dubai), IT. You will also work with the Arabian Center branch manager on delivery.

What you need:

Required

- At least 2 years operational experience within an automotive workshop, detailing or PPF operations and managing a team in this space

- Experience with job cards, standard times and stock counts

-A team player who believes in providing a quality service and a productive working environment

-UAE drivers licence

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE THE REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AS (WITH RESPECT) YOU WILL BE WASTING OUR TIME AND YOURS. YOU MAY ALSO DELAY OR BLOCK A SUITABLE APPLICANT FROM FINDING THEIR NEW ROLE.

Preferred

- Hindi or Urdu speaking

Skills

Operational control, leadership of supervisors, problem solving, reporting with numbers.

Working conditions

You will move between sites in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, with time at head office.

We are a Dubai-based group of technology and media ventures and a direct partner of BytePlus (the enterprise arm of ByteDance). Through this partnership we distribute BytePlus AI model APIs — including the Seedance video models and other generative AI services — to businesses in the UAE and the region.

We are looking for a technical person who can run this distribution business day to day: manage the BytePlus partner and API panels, onboard and support our customers, and understand the business well enough to grow it. This is a hybrid role — half engineer, half account manager. You must be able to write code, read API docs and debug an integration, and you must also be able to sit with a customer, understand what they need and keep them happy and paying.

Key Responsibilities1. BytePlus panels and API operations

* Work daily with the BytePlus partner / distribution console and model API platform (e.g. ModelArk).
* Create and manage customer accounts, sub-accounts, API keys, quotas, rate limits and access to models.
* Monitor usage, consumption and spend per customer; catch abnormal usage or misuse early.
* Handle top-ups, credits, pricing tiers and usage reports in line with our agreement with BytePlus.
* Be our main technical contact with the BytePlus partner team: raise tickets, escalate issues, follow new model releases and changes to pricing or terms.

2. Customer onboarding and technical support

* Onboard new customers: account setup, API keys, first successful call, and getting them to production.
* Help customers integrate the APIs into their products: explain endpoints, authentication, parameters, async jobs and webhooks, error codes and limits.
* Write sample code, quick-start guides and simple integration examples (Python and/or JavaScript).
* Troubleshoot integration problems: read logs, reproduce errors, find whether the issue is on the customer side, our side or BytePlus's side.
* Run short technical demos and proof-of-concepts for prospects.

3. Account management

* Own a portfolio of customer accounts: regular check-ins, usage reviews and renewals.
* Understand each customer's use case and recommend the right models, settings and plans.
* Spot upsell opportunities (more volume, new models, higher tiers) and early signs of churn.
* Keep a clean CRM record of every account: contacts, contracts, usage, issues and next steps.

4. Business understanding and reporting

* Understand how our distribution business makes money: wholesale cost, resale price, margin, volume commitments and payment terms.
* Prepare a monthly report: usage per customer, revenue, margin, top issues and growth opportunities.
* Give input on pricing, packaging and which customer segments to target.
* Follow the AI model API market (competitors, pricing, new models) and share what matters.

5. Internal tooling and automation

* Build small internal tools and scripts: usage dashboards, billing reconciliation, alerts, customer reports.
* Automate repetitive panel and reporting work using the available APIs.
* Keep internal documentation and runbooks up to date.

* Solid programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.

* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.

* Oversee policy development, document control, review cycles, approvals, version control and compliance with approved hospital policies and procedures.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, safety culture and service-quality indicators, and coordinate sustainable improvement actions.

* Demonstrated experience in mock surveys, tracers, clinical audits, incident investigations, RCA, CAPA, risk registers, quality indicators and executive dashboards.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary quality-improvement projects and support organisational change in a complex hospital environment.
* Experience managing quality teams, governance committees, policies, training programmes, departmental budgets and regulatory or accreditation evidence.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CPPS, Lean Six Sigma, Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor or an equivalent healthcare quality or risk credential is preferred.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

Material QA/QC Inspector is responsible for inspecting, testing, and verifying construction materials used in infrastructure and utility projects to ensure compliance with approved material submittals, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable authority requirements. The role involves conducting material inspections, reviewing test reports and certifications, monitoring material storage and traceability, identifying non-conforming materials, and coordinating with project teams to ensure only approved materials are incorporated into the works. The Material QA/QC Inspector plays a key role in maintaining quality assurance and quality control standards throughout the construction lifecycle.

* Conduct inspections of construction materials delivered to site to ensure compliance with approved material submittals, project specifications, and relevant authority standards.
* Inspect materials used in roadworks, wet utilities, dry utilities, drainage, sewerage, and other infrastructure construction activities.
* Verify material inspection requests (MIRs) and ensure all materials are inspected and approved prior to installation or incorporation into the works.
* Check material identification, manufacturer details, technical datasheets, conformity certificates, test certificates, and delivery documentation.
* Inspect construction materials, including cement, concrete, reinforcement steel, aggregates, asphalt, road base, subbase, soil, HDPE, GRP, DI pipes, valves, fittings, cables, and other infrastructure materials.
* Ensure delivered materials comply with approved samples, specifications, dimensions, grades, and required technical standards.
* Verify proper storage, handling, transportation, and protection of materials at site to prevent damage, deterioration, or contamination.
* Coordinate with the QA/QC Engineer, Material Engineer, discipline engineers, and contractors regarding material inspections and approvals.
* Witness sampling and laboratory testing of construction materials in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
* Verify material test reports and certificates to ensure compliance with specified quality requirements.
* Identify damaged, defective, expired, or non-conforming materials and recommend rejection or replacement in accordance with project procedures.
* Monitor the traceability and proper identification of approved materials throughout the construction process.
* Ensure materials are procured from approved manufacturers and suppliers in accordance with project requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of material inspections, approvals, test reports, rejected materials, and related documentation.
* Report material quality issues and non-compliances to the QA/QC Engineer and Resident Engineer for necessary corrective action.
* Ensure compliance with project QA/QC procedures, HSE requirements, and applicable authority standards.
* Participate in material audits, site inspections, and quality meetings as required.
* Prepare daily material inspection reports and maintain updated material inspection registers.
* Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for project completion and final handover.

 **Qualifications**  

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7 **years of experience** in QA/QC inspection of construction materials on infrastructure, roads, utilities, sewerage, drainage, water, wastewater, or industrial projects.
* Strong knowledge of construction materials including concrete, reinforcement steel, aggregates, asphalt, road base, subbase, soil, HDPE, GRP, ductile iron (DI) pipes, valves, fittings, and utility materials.
* Experience reviewing Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), material submittals, test certificates, manufacturer certificates, and compliance documentation.
* Familiarity with project specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and quality management systems.
* Experience witnessing material sampling, field testing, and laboratory testing activities.
* Knowledge of international standards and specifications such as ASTM, AASHTO, BS, EN, ACI, and relevant authority requirements.
* Ability to identify, document, and report non-conforming materials and recommend corrective actions.
* Experience monitoring material storage, traceability, protection, and handling procedures.
* Strong understanding of QA/QC procedures, material approvals, inspection records, and project documentation requirements.
* Proficient in preparing inspection reports, material registers, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and quality records.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors, suppliers, laboratory personnel, engineers, and project stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems is preferred.
* Knowledge of HSE requirements and safe material handling practices.

**About The Role**
Establish and lead Powertech’s new Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO) business unit, servicing the P-series piston engines (10–200 HP class) operated by EDGE platform companies and regional and international UAV customers, and later other engine types in the portfolio (e.g., microjets).
  
  
The role starts as a build role — business case, project plan, statements of work, facility, approvals and team — and becomes an operating role with full P&L, budget and headcount accountability. It also owns the Abu Dhabi engine test facility as a shared service for MRO acceptance testing and product development testing.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Business Case & Stand-up**

* Business case — build and present the MRO business case (installed base, service offering, pricing, capex/opex, headcount, break-even, risks); own its delivery.
* Project plan & SOW — build the stand-up project plan and write the statements of work (facility fit-out, equipment and tooling, MRO/ERP software, subcontracts); run the project to plan.
* Facility & approvals — define and deliver the MRO facility, tooling and processes; obtain the applicable approvals (authorised service centre, AS9100/AS9110, CAR-145/Part-145 or military airworthiness as required).

**Business Unit P&L**

* P&L — own revenue, cost, margin and working capital; produce budget, forecasts and monthly reporting.
* Service offering — define and price repairs, overhauls, exchange pools, spares, long-term support agreements and field service; negotiate with customers alongside Commercial.
* Growth — develop the aftermarket with EDGE platform companies and regional/international operators; build business cases for MRO of other engine types.

**MRO Operations**

* Processes — establish work-scoping, inspection standards, repair schemes, build standards and release to service; maintain manuals with Engineering.
* Delivery — plan capacity and shifts; manage turnaround time, on-time delivery and first-time yield.
* Spares & field service — define spares provisioning and traceability; stand up field service and rapid-response support.

**Test Facility**

* Asset owner — own the engine test facility (test cells, dynamometers, DAQ, fuel and safety systems): availability, maintenance, calibration, upgrades and capex.
* Shared service — run acceptance and post-overhaul testing for MRO and development, endurance and qualification testing for the product programmes; agree priorities with Product Managers and Test & Development.
* Safety & operations — own SOPs, test-cell safety, operator authorisation, configuration control and test data integrity.

**Team**

* Hire & build — define the organisation and hire the team; transfer build, overhaul and test know-how from the Powertech Italy facility.
* Lead — set objectives, manage performance and develop people; safety-first, quality-first culture.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Quality system — implement the MRO quality system (AS9100/AS9110) with Quality; own release documentation, records and traceability.
* HSE & compliance — own health, safety and environmental compliance for the workshop and test facility, and export-control compliance for parts and technical data.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical or Automotive Engineering, or equivalent technical qualification with substantial hands-on experience.
* 10+ years in engine/powertrain MRO, after-sales or test, including 5+ years leading a maintenance, overhaul or test operation with budget or P&L accountability.
* Experience standing up a new operation, facility or business line from business case to steady-state operation.
* Hands-on knowledge of piston engine build, overhaul and test.
* Experience under aviation maintenance approvals or equivalent quality systems (Part-145/CAR-145, AS9100/AS9110, military airworthiness).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* UAV/RPAS engine experience; 2-stroke, heavy-fuel and/or EFI engines; microjets.
* Defence/military customer environment; GCC market; test-cell design or commissioning.
* MRO/ERP system implementation; Lean/Six Sigma; PMP/PRINCE2; Italian or Arabic.

Technical Skills & Tools
  
  

* MRO processes (work-scoping, repair schemes, release to service) and reliability programmes (TBO, MTBUR, warranty).
* Engine test-cell infrastructure and operations (dynamometers, DAQ, fuel and safety systems); test data interpretation.
* Business-case and P&L modelling, budgeting, project management, SOW writing, supplier management; MRO/ERP systems.

**Overview**
------------

The **Quantity Surveyor** is responsible for managing and monitoring quantity surveying, cost management, and commercial activities on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC). The role involves coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure project costs, quantities, variations, valuations, and contractual matters are managed effectively in accordance with project requirements, quality standards, contractual obligations, budgetary controls, and project governance frameworks. The Quantity Surveyor will provide commercial support, monitor project performance, evaluate financial risks, and ensure accurate cost reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* Lead and manage quantity surveying and commercial activities from design review through construction, commissioning, and project handover.
* Review and monitor cost plans, bills of quantities, estimates, tender documentation, contracts, and commercial submissions.
* Ensure project costs and commercial activities comply with project requirements, contractual obligations, procurement strategies, and industry standards.
* Monitor contractor performance and assess progress against approved budgets, schedules, and contractual milestones.
* Review and evaluate contractor valuations, interim payment applications, variations, change requests, claims, and final accounts.
* Coordinate quantity surveying interfaces with civil, structural, landscape, infrastructure, utility, architectural, MEP, and specialist project disciplines.

* Monitor project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on project cost, schedule, and commercial performance.

* Evaluate variations, claims, extension of time submissions, compensation events, and change management requests and provide recommendations.
* Track project KPIs, cost reports, forecasts, budgets, commitments, cash flow, and performance metrics for management and client review.
* Ensure proper commercial closeout, final account settlement, and project handover procedures are completed successfully.
* Support procurement activities including tender evaluations, bid assessments, cost benchmarking, and vendor commercial reviews.
* Drive resolution of contractual and commercial issues affecting project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, quality management, and project governance requirements.
* Support and mentor junior commercial staff and project teams in quantity surveying and cost management practices.

**About you**
-------------

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Civil Engineering, Commercial Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5-10 years of experience in quantity surveying, commercial management, cost control, or contract administration, with significant experience in PMC, consultancy, or client-side project delivery roles.
* Proven experience managing large-scale infrastructure, landscape, transportation, utilities, mixed-use, or mega development projects.
* Strong knowledge of cost planning, estimating, valuation, measurement, procurement, contract administration, change management, and commercial reporting.
* Experience overseeing tendering, construction cost management, claims assessment, variation evaluation, final accounts, and project handover activities.

* Strong knowledge of project governance frameworks, cost control systems, and financial management methodologies.

  + Rapid Impact Compaction

  + Prefabricated Vertical Drains (PVD)

**1. Job Purpose**

The Quantity Surveyor (QS) is responsible for managing and monitoring all financial and contractual aspects of construction projects. The role ensures accurate measurement of construction works, cost estimation, preparation of Bills of Quantities (BOQ), progress payment applications, variation claims, subcontractor payments, and final accounts.

The QS works closely with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Engineer, Procurement Department, Finance Department, Consultants, Clients, and Subcontractors to ensure that projects are delivered within the approved budget and contractual requirements.

**2. Main Duties and ResponsibilitiesA. Pre-Contract / Tendering Responsibilities**

* Review tender documents, drawings, specifications, and contract requirements.
* Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
* Prepare cost estimates, rate analysis, and tender pricing.
* Obtain quotations from suppliers and subcontractors.
* Evaluate and compare subcontractor and supplier quotations.
* Prepare tender clarifications and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Identify discrepancies, omissions, and potential cost risks in tender documents.
* Assist in preparing commercial and technical tender submissions.

**B. Post-Contract / Project Responsibilities**

* Monitor project costs against the approved budget.
* Measure and verify actual completed works at the project site.
* Prepare monthly Interim Payment Applications (IPA).
* Prepare and submit Progress Claims to the Client or Consultant.
* Review and verify subcontractors' payment applications and invoices.
* Prepare, evaluate, and submit Variation Orders (VOs).
* Monitor additional works, omissions, and changes in project scope.
* Maintain records of project quantities, costs, and financial commitments.
* Prepare monthly cost reports and cash flow forecasts.
* Coordinate with the site team to verify work progress and completed quantities.

**C. Contract Administration**

* Review contract agreements, conditions, and commercial requirements.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and submission deadlines.
* Prepare contractual letters, notices, and commercial correspondence.
* Follow up on pending approvals, variations, and payment certificates.
* Review contractual claims and supporting documentation.
* Assist in Extension of Time (EOT) and cost claim submissions.
* Maintain proper documentation of contractual correspondence and approvals.

**D. Subcontractor and Supplier Management**

* Prepare and review subcontract agreements.
* Evaluate subcontractor quotations and commercial proposals.
* Verify subcontractor progress claims and invoices.
* Monitor subcontractor work progress and payment status.
* Coordinate with Procurement regarding material costs and purchase orders.
* Negotiate rates and commercial terms with suppliers and subcontractors.
* Ensure that subcontractor payments are properly supported by approved documents.

**E. Final Account and Project Closing**

* Prepare and finalize the project's final account.
* Reconcile actual project costs against the approved budget.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and retention releases.
* Finalize subcontractor accounts.
* Prepare final variation statements and outstanding claims.
* Ensure all commercial documents are properly recorded and submitted.

The Airworthiness Review Lead is responsible for ensuring the continued validity of the aircraft airworthiness certificate. Delivered through leading and managing the airworthiness review schedule to ensure the management of a full, documented, review of an aircraft’s records, together with a physical survey, confirms that the aircraft has remained within a controlled environment since either delivery or the previous airworthiness review. Further ensuring the robust ARC planning at strategic and tactical levels, maximising the operational efficiency of the QEAF Typhoon fleet.

In addition, the ARC Lead is responsible for leading and developing a culture of Continuous Improvement within CAMSS instigating change. Further acting as the CAMSS Continuing Airworthiness SME when leading and conducting safety investigations as tasked.
  
  
  
Core Activity
  
  
  

· Manage the development, production and issuance of QEAF Typhoon ARC certificates to satisfy the required schedule conducting a fully documented airworthiness review of the aircraft and records at intervals, as required by the QEAFAR.

· Manage the reconciliation activities (findings) identified during an airworthiness review, ensuring that they are captured, recorded, communicated and acted upon within the required timescales. Ensuring that escalated issues, identified by the airworthiness review process, are assessed and effective solutions are implemented.

· At a strategic level, manage the maintenance planning and conducting of airworthiness reviews ensuring that detachments, or any other incidents of aircraft unavailability, are deconflicted. Maximising the operational efficiency of the QEAF Typhoon Fleet. Further capturing fleet trends that identify fleet wide issues that could manifest a risk to CAw.

· At a tactical level manage stakeholder interaction to deconflict the ARC schedule with other aircraft activities. Ensure the effective communication throughout the stakeholder chain to highlight ARC priorities and subsequent findings.

· Lead and develop the effectiveness of CAMSS through Continuous Improvement. Identifying process and policy insufficiencies that increase the risk to CAw, generating suitable reports and plans to communicate and manage the changes identified.

Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

**The Role**

The Vendor Integration team owns every fintech connection in our product suite. That includes payment and card vendors, identity and fraud vendors, data aggregators, and the SSO that brings third-party products seamlessly into our apps.

The team is small and generalist by design: five engineers and one QA working across the entire vendor surface. As the team's only Project Manager, you own every PRD, every vendor decision, and every roadmap call in this space. If you want real ownership and a direct line from your decisions to production, this is the role.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Take vendors from first call to production.** You'll dig into vendor API packages (Swagger specs, Postman collections, SSO and iFrame guides, certification checklists) before kickoff and find what the docs imply but don't say. You'll run the open-question list with each vendor, hold the line on scope and schedule, and own the pilot client relationship through UAT and go-live.
* **Write specs engineers love to build from.** You'll write clear, readable PRDs and a companion context doc covering vendor requirements, gaps, tech debt, decisions, and open questions. You'll run a readiness check before engineering starts and break epics into small, testable stories that QA can accept with confidence.
* **Do your own technical diligence.** You'll read our .NET backend and Angular frontend to understand how existing integrations work before anything is sized. You'll spot the surprises early, decide what can be reused, and occasionally ship a small change yourself on a branch when that's faster than writing a ticket.

* **Design without waiting.** You'll create first-draft screens in Figma using our design system and hand them to design for review. When a flow needs to be clicked to be understood, you'll build an HTML prototype.
* **Build your own tooling.** We treat repeated PM work as a target for automation. You'll build and maintain AI agent skills that other PMs can use, keep a structured team knowledge base, and choose the simplest tool that gets the job done.
* **Lead the squad.** You'll set priorities with the Tech Lead, sequence the roadmap against client contracts and vendor certification timelines, run sprint planning and backlog grooming, and own the Jira board. When someone asks "is this a bug or a setting?", you'll know the answer quickly.

* **Data and identity.** External account linking and aggregation, identity verification, credit score, and payroll and subscription connectivity.
* **Documents and imaging.** eStatement SSO and check-image retrieval across multiple providers.
* **What comes next.** New client contracts bring new vendors every quarter. You'll shape how each one joins the platform.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Product management**

* 4+ years as a product manager on a B2B platform, with at least 2 years in integrations, payments, or fintech infrastructure.
* You've shipped at least one third-party integration end to end: vendor evaluation, requirements, certification, pilot, and production.
* You write clearly and concisely. Short sentences, active voice, no filler. (We'll ask for a writing sample.)
* You've managed a vendor relationship where the vendor's process set the schedule.

**Technical**

* You can read C# and TypeScript well enough to trace a code path, spot a missing piece, and estimate a change.
* You're comfortable with git (branches, rebases, diffs, cherry-picks) and can open a PR.
* You understand SSO and API auth patterns in practice: OAuth client credentials, token exchange (RFC 8693), SAML, JWKS, signed URLs, and iframe postMessage.
* You can derive requirements from an OpenAPI spec or Postman collection.
* You know what puts a flow in PCI scope and what doesn't.

* You understand the credit union and community bank buyer. The institution is the client, the account holder is the user, and both need to be happy.

* You ship first drafts fast and iterate in the open.

**About the role**

Andorix is hiring an Account Manager to own the day-to-day relationship with one of our most important clients, a major institutional real estate investment, operating and development company with a large and growing portfolio across Canada and internationally. The work we do for them spans across multiple active projects and an ongoing service relationship.

This role is the connective tissue between the client and our internal teams. You will track the projects we are delivering, keep open issues moving to resolution, and make sure the client always knows where things stand.

You will also own new business within the account. This client is a strong supporter of Andorix and regularly brings opportunities to us. We need someone who picks those up, runs them properly and closes them. We need a person who owns the sales process end to end, from first conversation through scoping, proposal, pricing, negotiation and signature, and who follows through without dropping anything.

This is not a deeply technical engineering role. You need to be technical enough to hold a credible conversation about IT projects, understand what our teams are building, and translate that into language a business audience understands. What matters more is that you are an outstanding communicator who builds trust quickly, presents well and follows through without being chased.

**What you will do**

Project tracking and delivery

* Maintain a clear, current view of every active project we are running for the client, including scope, timeline, dependencies and status.
* Run regular status reviews with the client and keep our internal teams aligned on commitments and deadlines.
* Flag risks and slippage early. Bring problems forward before they become surprises.

Issue and ticket coordination

* Act as the single point of contact for the client on unresolved issues.
* Track aging tickets through to resolution, coordinate the right internal resources, and drive escalations when something stalls.
* Keep the client informed on status without them having to ask.

Client relationship

* Build strong working relationships across the client organization, from operations teams up to senior leadership.
* Understand their business, their properties and their priorities well enough to anticipate what they need.
* Be the person the client calls first.

Communication and presentations

* Prepare and deliver account reviews, status reports and project updates.
* Support senior Andorix leaders in executive level presentations to the client, and grow into leading those conversations independently.
* Translate technical detail into clear business terms for a non-technical audience.

Sales and new business

* Own opportunities within the account from first conversation through to close. This includes qualification, scoping with our technical teams, proposal development, pricing input, negotiation and signature.
* Respond quickly and thoroughly to every opportunity the client brings us. Follow through is the single biggest thing we need to improve.
* Build and present proposals and pitches to client decision makers, including at the executive level.
* Maintain a visible pipeline of open opportunities with realistic timelines and close probability, and report on it to Andorix leadership.
* Identify additional work we are well positioned to win and bring it forward proactively.
* Support renewal and expansion conversations on existing agreements.
* Uncover opportunities with tenants inside the client’s buildings. These are separate businesses from our client and a real source of new work for Andorix. Qualify what you find, then hand it cleanly to a member of the sales team to carry forward.

**What we are looking for**

* **Four to six years of experience** in a client facing role such as account management, solution sales, business development, service delivery or project coordination, ideally within IT services, managed services, technology or a related field.
* **Experience owning a sales cycle through to close.** You have carried an opportunity from first conversation to signed agreement, and you can walk us through how you did it. Formal quota experience is helpful but not required.
* **Strong technical literacy.** You can hold your own in a conversation about IT projects, infrastructure and systems. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to understand the work well enough to scope and sell it.
* **Exceptional communication.** You write clearly, present well and adjust your message to your audience. This is the most important requirement in the role.
* **Relationship builder.** People trust you, come back to you and want to work with you.
* **Organized and reliable.** You track a lot of moving pieces without dropping any of them. You follow up. You close the loop.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Andorix is growing and this role is new. You will help define how it works.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in commercial real estate, property technology, building systems or construction.
* Experience selling professional or managed services into enterprise clients.
* Familiarity with ticketing, CRM and project management tools.
* An engineering or computer science degree. We are not asking this person to design solutions, but a technical education makes it easier to speak the same language as our teams and our clients.
* Post secondary education in a technology, business or related discipline.

**How we will measure success**

In the first year, we expect this role to deliver on six things:

* Every opportunity the client brings us gets a fast, complete response. Nothing goes cold because we did not follow up.
* New business is closed within the account against an agreed target.
* The client is satisfied with how we deliver and how we communicate.
* Projects run on schedule and issues resolve without escalation to senior leadership.
* Andorix has a clear, current and shared picture of everything happening in the account, including the open pipeline.
* Tenant opportunities inside the client’s buildings are being surfaced, qualified and handed to the sales team.

Base salary of C$80,000 to C$90,000 per year, based on experience.

Performance bonus with a target of 25 percent of base salary, paid quarterly, based on sales and client satisfaction targets. Total target compensation is approximately C$100,000 to C$112,500, with additional earnings available above target.

**Job Summary**

The Program Manager, Pre University Programs is responsible for the planning, development, delivery and evaluation of Extended Learning’s portfolio of educational programs for Canadian and international high school students. The portfolio includes UBC Future Global Leaders, a large summer program with academic, extracurricular and residential components, as well as year round online and applied technology programs. Serving more than 1,500 students annually and generating over $5 million in revenue.

The Manager leads program planning and manages the interdependent academic, staffing, financial and operational requirements of the portfolio. The role is accountable for program quality, student experience and welfare, and achievement of enrolment and financial targets. The Manager directs professional and support staff, supervises contract instructors, and oversees summer staff through the Student Life Manager, ensuring that teaching, activities and residence arrangements operate as a coordinated program.

The Manager develops program policies and delivery practices within ExL and UBC requirements, leads program improvement and new program development, and manages relationships that support recruitment and growth. The role is responsible for balancing educational objectives, financial sustainability and the needs of a diverse population of students aged 15 to 18, including international students requiring custodianship and residential support.  
  
**Organizational Status**

The position will report to the Director, Strategic Partnerships and Programs. The Manager works with instructors, faculty, program staff, the ExL marketing team, International Student Initiative and Student Recruitment to plan and deliver the portfolio. The role maintains relationships with external educational partners and recruitment stakeholders and serves as a point of contact for parents on matters affecting their children’s participation and welfare.  
  
**Work Performed**  
  
**Program Planning and Development**

* Leads the development of goals, priorities and plans for ExL’s pre university portfolio, translating program objectives into educational offerings and delivery requirements.
* Conducts market research, assesses student needs, and exchanges information with other universities offering pre university programs to identify opportunities for new offerings, improvement and growth.
* Manages the development and delivery of summer, online and applied technology programs, including the review and redesign of existing offerings, considering educational value, student needs, delivery capacity and financial sustainability.
* Oversees the development and delivery of non credit academic courses taught at the first year university level, working with instructors to ensure that content and teaching approaches are appropriately adapted for domestic and international high school students.
* Oversees university preparation workshops and lectures delivered by ExL instructors and contractors, ensuring that offerings support program objectives and students’ transition to university learning.
* Leads program evaluation and uses findings to improve curriculum, teaching practices, delivery arrangements and student experience.

**Student Experience and Welfare**

* Oversees the planning and delivery of on campus and off campus extracurricular activities for the Future Global Leaders summer program at UBC Vancouver.
* Manages the residential component through the Student Life Manager and summer staff team, ensuring that students are appropriately supervised and that residence arrangements support their safety and participation in the program.
* Manages complex student welfare and conduct matters, including injuries requiring hospitalization, homesickness and mental health concerns, and coordinates appropriate responses with staff and relevant services.
* Serves as a point of contact for parents regarding student concerns and incidents and acts as the designated custodian for international students as required.
* Leads the development and delivery of bursaries and other financial benefits.

**Financial Management, Marketing and Partnerships**

* Develops the annual budget for the pre university portfolio, accounting for academic delivery, staffing, residence, activities, marketing and other operating requirements.
* Sets and manages gross and net revenue targets and is responsible for achieving the portfolio’s budget objectives.
* Oversees and approves expenditures within the annual budget, including payroll for program staff. Monitors financial performance and manages resources in relation to enrolment, delivery requirements and program commitments.
* Provides program marketing direction and budget to the ExL marketing team, working with the team to develop and implement marketing strategies and approving program marketing materials.
* Provides direction and budget for International Student Initiative and Student Recruitment activities promoting Future Global Leaders.
* Leads social media activities for the pre university portfolio, ensuring that promotional content reflects program offerings and intended audiences.
* Develops business opportunities and maintains partnerships with external stakeholders, including BC Offshore Schools, to promote programs, support student recruitment and contribute to portfolio growth and sustainability.
* Participates in relevant professional associations, including the Association for Pre College Program Directors, to maintain professional networks and inform program practices.

**Program Administration**

* Provides direction to professional and support staff and contract instructors, coordinating responsibilities across academic programming, program administration and student life.
* Develops and oversees staff training and program specific staff policies, including conduct expectations, in alignment with ExL and UBC policies.
* Develops and implements student and program policies and procedures, including those addressing student conduct, registration, withdrawals and refunds, within ExL and UBC requirements.
* Oversees improvements to administrative processes and the use of technology to support educational delivery and improve coordination, consistency and efficiency across the portfolio.
* Performs other related duties as required.

**Why this Role is Important**

At Fanshawe College, Environment, Health, Safety and Emergency Services is dedicated to supporting a campus environment where safety, health, and preparedness are integrated into every aspect of work and operations. The department provides strategic leadership and operational expertise in occupational health and safety, emergency management, environmental compliance, and risk reduction, helping to protect people, property, and the environment. Through collaboration, education, and continuous improvement, the team helps foster a culture where safe and healthy practices are demonstrated, supported, and expected. In doing so, Environment, Health, Safety and Emergency Services not only supports employee well-being and organizational excellence but also contributes to a learning environment where students observe and develop workplace behaviours that can be carried forward into their future careers.

This role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the safety and resilience of the Fanshawe College community. The successful candidate will support and enhance emergency preparedness, life safety, and business continuity programs through training, exercises, emergency planning, and operational readiness initiatives. Working collaboratively with internal and external partners, the incumbent will help strengthen individual preparedness, emergency response capabilities, and a culture of readiness across the College.

Reporting to the Manager, Environment Health, Safety and Emergency Operations, the incumbent serves as the College operational specialist for emergency preparedness, life safety and emergency response readiness and is responsible for administration, auditing, inspecting, testing, exercising and training related to life safety and emergency management systems and equipment.

The incumbent supports the departments emergency management objectives and the College’s Emergency Management and Business Continuity Program by conducting hazard identification and risk analyses, coordinating the implementation, maintenance, testing and continuous improvement of approved emergency procedures and plans, and assists College departments in the implementation and maintenance of business continuity plans.

The incumbent organizes and leads daily operation of the Student Emergency Response Team and develops and conducts community emergency preparedness education and promotion programs. The incumbent responds to and provides logistical support for major College emergencies, tracks, monitors and reports on corrective actions arising from exercises, incident responses and program evaluations. They coordinate the development, implementation and maintenance of Personal Emergency Plans (PEP) and associated preparedness measures for individuals requiring assistance during emergencies. Supports the delivery of emergency communications and campus safety initiatives through the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Fanshawe Stay Safe App and related emergency communication systems.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Develops personal emergency plans for persons with disabilities, medical limitations and/or special needs
* Maintains operational readiness of the College for emergency response by inspecting, updating and purchasing replacement supplies for critical life safety equipment like first aid kits and AED’s and ensures emergency control measures such as the emergency floor wardens are up to date, published and trained for emergency situations
* Administers and maintains the Fanshawe Stay Safe App, including emergency communication content, user support, testing, and implementation of approved system updates to support effective emergency notifications and safety communications.
* Stays up to date on industry standards that advance prevention, mitigation, response and recovery elements of emergency management
* Coordinates community education, training, drills and exercises in support of the College’s life safety systems and Emergency Management and Business Continuity Program and related plans and procedures
* Coordinates post-exercise and post-incident reviews to identify lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement
* Conducts Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment reviews and provides recommendations regarding prevention, mitigation, training, preparedness, response and recovery measures required
* Organizes and assumes overall responsibility for daily operation of the Student Emergency Response Team including overseeing recruiting and screening, scheduling and conducting training, maintaining inventory and ordering of supplies and equipment
* Provides support for Student Team Leaders and volunteers, organizing team appreciation events monitoring operational readiness and service standards are maintained
* Auditing, inspecting, testing and coordinating maintenance of equipment, to ensure operational effectiveness
* Ensures adequate supplies are maintained (as required) as well as periodic replacement and preventative maintenance of life safety equipment according to college policies and procedures and ensures compliance with Health and Safety legislation
* Organizes and maintains department records including records of inspections, tests, maintenance, repair, training, exercises and response to major emergencies including diagrams, maps and schematics required for emergency purposes as well as inventory of emergency equipment and user manuals, instructions and procedures for use
* Generates statistics and prepares reports as required
* Conducts research on emergency management and business continuity practices, procedures, training and equipment and makes recommendations to the Manager to ensure consistency with industry best practices

**The Opportunity**
Lead the strategy, delivery, governance, and operational excellence of the technology platforms that power engineering applications around the world. In this leadership role, you will shape secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective environments across application hosting, cloud and vendor-hosted platforms, virtual desktop infrastructure, data governance, automation, and future-ready engineering technologies. Working across Client Delivery Solutions, Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Data & AI, and Engineering, you will help project teams and engineering professionals deliver at their best while preparing WSP for what comes next.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Shape engineering platform strategy and operations: Define and govern the technology platform strategy supporting global engineering applications. Ensure operational readiness, availability, performance, resilience, scalability, and security across engineering technology environments. Establish platform standards, technical governance frameworks, service operating procedures, lifecycle plans, and modernization initiatives.
* Advance virtual desktop infrastructure and engineering computing: Own the strategy and roadmap for engineering VDI and remote computing environments. Partner with Infrastructure teams to optimize performance, user experience, graphics acceleration, and engineering workloads. Define standards for engineering workstations, cloud workstations, and hybrid delivery models, while evaluating future engineering computing technologies and deployment approaches.
* Govern demand delivery and resources: Oversee the intake, prioritization, and delivery of engineering technology initiatives. Manage resource allocation, team capacity planning, and delivery priorities. Partner with CDS Front Door, PMO, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to execute platform initiatives successfully, while monitoring delivery performance, risks, dependencies, and value realization.
* Strengthen data governance and information lifecycle management: Define governance and lifecycle management practices for engineering application data. Establish strategies for retention, archiving, recovery, compliance, business continuity, and long-term accessibility. Govern vendor-hosted and WSP cloud-hosted application environments, collaborating with Data Governance, Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to meet corporate standards and support analytics, AI, and digital delivery initiatives.
* Accelerate future-ready technology and innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, AI-enabled engineering platforms, and automation opportunities. Develop technology roadmaps supporting evolving engineering delivery models. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, scalability, sustainability, and user experience, and lead proof-of-concepts, innovation pilots, and technology modernization programs.
* Lead platform governance and cross-functional delivery: Partner with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and Operations teams to ensure platform alignment. Define technical standards, change management practices, and operational governance processes. Ensure engineering platform changes are tested, documented, and operationally supported, while providing leadership for complex technical escalations and enterprise-wide platform initiatives.
* Own financial management and executive leadership: Manage platform budgets, forecasts, investment planning, and optimization initiatives. Develop business cases and technology investment recommendations, drive cost optimization across cloud, infrastructure, hosting, and operational services, and deliver executive reporting, dashboards, presentations, and governance updates.
* Build the global operating model and team: Lead and develop a global team of platform and engineering technology specialists. Design and implement scalable delivery and support models. Drive workforce planning, capability development, upskilling, and succession planning. Establish governance and engagement models for business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams, fostering accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**The Skills That Set You Apart**

* Education and enterprise platform leadership: A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, combined with significant experience managing enterprise platforms, infrastructure services, cloud technologies, or engineering application environments.
* Engineering computing expertise: Experience with VDI, engineering computing environments, cloud-hosting platforms, and enterprise-scale application delivery, including experience supporting engineering, BIM, GIS, digital delivery, simulation, or design application ecosystems.
* Data governance depth: A strong understanding of data governance, retention, archiving, recovery, and information lifecycle management practices, along with knowledge of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and data governance frameworks.
* Complex delivery leadership: Experience managing technical delivery portfolios and complex cross-functional initiatives using ITIL, Agile, SAFe, or comparable delivery methodologies.

**About Magma Math**
Magma is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education through the power of AI. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning — while giving them real-time visibility into student progress.
  
  
The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.
  
  
But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math — a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths — we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.
  
  
We’re already the go-to solution in thousands of schools — and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.
  
  
****The Role****
As the Customer Success Manager, you will oversee and nurture portfolio of Canadian board partners and play a powerful role in ensuring educators successfully implement and see continuous value from Magma Math. We're growing quickly across Ontario and the rest of Canada, so this is a big opportunity to play a critical role within Magma Math Canada.
  
  
Your primary mission is to build and grow relationships with math leadership and to onboard teachers, coaches, and school leaders and see through their long term success with Magma. As a CSM, you will be highly visible to schools and will communicate frequently with board stakeholders including administrators, coaches, curriculum directors, and teachers. With deep product knowledge and a customer-centric mindset, you will advise leaders on how to leverage Magma’s products and services to achieve their goals of supporting teachers in the classroom and student growth. You will work with coaches and teachers to ensure product adoption and best practices in the classroom, promoting exemplary mathematical instruction and discourse among teachers and students.
  
  
As a team player, you will collaborate with the CS team to exceed board partners’ expectations and continuously support and delight our customers. Equally important, you will enhance the customer experience by working closely with other Magma teams including Account Management, Product, Curriculum, and Sales, aligning on a shared vision for supporting board partners and providing the best experience possible.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with board and math leaders
* Provide onboarding and continued professional learning for teachers, guiding their use of the Magma Math platform
* Understand each board's unique needs and objectives as they pertain to their larger goals for Magma in the classroom
* Regularly communicate with customers to check on their satisfaction and provide assistance
* Guide new customers through the onboarding process to ensure a successful implementation
* Provide virtual and onsite training and resources focused on using Magma in the best way possible to effectively support district and classroom goals
* Take a data-driven approach to customer work, using trend and health information to identify opportunities to strengthen adoption
* Strategize about low usage and at risk accounts, working closely with Account Managers to ensure our customers’ successful renewal
* Identify growth opportunities and work with Account Managers to expand customer accounts
* Encourage and support satisfied customers to become advocates, encouraging them to participate in case studies and testimonials
* Gather customer feedback and insights to inform product development and improvement. Work closely with Product, acting as the voice of the customer internally
* Analyze customer data and usage patterns to identify trends and opportunities for improvement

**What great looks like at Magma**
We hire, grow and review everyone against the same three pillars. For a Customer Success Manager that means:
  
  

* Ownership, Initiatives & Execution: you own customer outcomes end to end, voice customer needs internally with clear asks, and focus on what moves the team's goals.
* Skills, Knowledge & Problem Solving: you build trusted partnerships with several stakeholders per customer, frame every conversation around impact and success criteria, and act as a trusted pedagogical advisor.
* Team player, Culture & Leadership: you know your strengths and limits, drive action across the team through trust, and decide independently while asking for a second opinion when needed.

**Your first year at Magma**

* First 30 days: you learn Magma's products and begin to get to know your boards and their stakeholders. You run customer onboarding with support from other team members
* By day 60: you run customer onboarding and professional learning on your own, with success criteria agreed with each board. You feel comfortable with internal process
* By day 90: you own your full book of business and contribute to the team's quarterly goals
* By six months: you share product insights regularly and openly and deliver results across your book, handling escalations and growing opportunities
* After a year: you've made a big impact both internally among the Magma team and externally. Boards see you as a trusted advisor

**What you'll bring to the Magma team:**

* 2-5 years of work experience as a Customer Success Manager
* Previous work in ed tech and/or education
* Desire to work in a scale-up environment
* Proven track record of building and retaining strong relationships
* Self-led and goal oriented
* A curious mindset with a strong eagerness to learn and understand the product's technical aspects
* Proactive problem solving and strong organizational abilities
* Experience in using data and evidence to inform decision-making
* High-energy and strong interpersonal skills
* Confidence and ease when speaking to large groups of people
* Flexibility with working across timezones and willingness to travel

**Why you'll love working here:**

* You'll be part of a growing tech scale-up with the incredibly important mission of positively impacting K-12 math education across the U.S.
* We're a supportive and highly collaborative team environment with so much space to learn and grow
* We invite your innovative ideas! Magma is open to new solutions and approaches. Your ideas and perspective will be incredibly valuable to the growth of Magma
* Visiting our partner board partners is a blast! You’ll see Magma in action in your region and across North America. Meeting our board teams in person is an incredibly rewarding experience and you’ll learn deeply how the product is impacting student learning

**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner. 

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. 

**This role is open to candidates residing in Canada.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**
  Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
* **You thrive the most when solving problems:**
  Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
* **You are a natural relationship builder:**
  Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
* **You are the architect of your own career:**
  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
* **You want to be with the best:**
  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

**In this role, you will:**

* Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
* Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
* Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals.
* Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products.
* Support French-speaking customers implementations.
* Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
* Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for this role:**

* 2 - 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. SaaS experience preferred.
* This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
* English and French fluency.
* Customer travel is expected. Up to 0-15%.
* Experience supporting or working with technical products.
* Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
* Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
* Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
* Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
* Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
* Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
* Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.
* French Fluency is a plus.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Quantity Surveyor** to join our team!

The Quantity Surveyor will provide cost management, contract administration, and commercial support across all packages of a mixed‑use development. Working in a PMC role, the QS safeguards the client’s financial interests by monitoring budgets, validating contractor payments, managing variations and claims, and ensuring accurate cost reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

  
  

* Provide input for value engineering and optimization options, highlighting cost impacts.
* Monitor project budget and expenditure against approved cost plans.
* Evaluate cost impact of design changes, site instructions, and scope variations.
* Prepare cost projections, cash‑flow forecasts, and financial status reports for the client.
* Carry out and/or validate measurements from drawings and on site for interim valuations.
* Coordinate with site teams to verify physical progress and reconcile with contractor claims.
* Maintain detailed records of measured quantities and variations for audit trail and final account.
* Support negotiations with contractors to reach commercially fair settlements.
* Ensure compliance with contract conditions (FIDIC or equivalent) related to notices, timelines, and procedures.
* Assist in preparation and agreement of final accounts.
* Identify cost and commercial risks (inflation, quantity overruns, design changes, delays) and highlight to PMC leadership.

* Communicate clearly with contractors and consultants on cost and contract matters, maintaining a professional and neutral approach.
* Ensure proper documentation and filing of: Contracts, addenda, and variation orders, Payment certificates and supporting measurement records, Correspondence related to commercial issues and claims.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of cost control processes and benchmarking for future projects.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related discipline; professional QS membership (e.g., MRICS) is an advantage.

* Experience within PMC organizations, consultants, or major contractors.
* Strong understanding of: Standard methods of measurement and BOQ preparation, Contract forms (e.g., FIDIC, NEC, local standard forms), Construction techniques for buildings and infrastructure, and their cost drivers.
* Proficiency in: MS Excel (advanced) for cost analysis and reporting, Cost management/QS software (e.g., Candy, CostX, or similar – desirable), MS Project/Primavera (basic understanding) for linking cost and time.
* Excellent numerical and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to work under time pressure while maintaining accuracy and integrity.
* Good understanding of both technical construction aspects and commercial implications.
* Ethical, transparent, and client‑focused approach to cost management.

* Batch ready mix concrete to approved mix designs, job specifications, and customer orders.

* Keep accurate batch records, including materials used, quantities, mix designs, and delivery tickets.
* Coordinate the day's pour schedule with dispatch, drivers, and customers so trucks load and leave on time.
* Monitor cement, fly ash, aggregate, and admixture levels and order materials before they run short.
* Help maintain and calibrate scales, meters, and batch computer systems; report malfunctions to maintenance right away.
* Keep the plant, yard, and batch office clean, organized, and safe.
* Reconcile cash sales and deposits, and maintain physical inventory counts and paperwork.
* Train and back up other batch personnel and hand off cleanly at shift changes

* Maximize utilization of all aggregate and powder trucks by planning loads and backhauls to cut empty miles and idle time.
* Staff the fleet: recruit, hire, onboard, and train drivers with HR and the Operations Manager.
* Build and publish daily and weekly driver and truck schedules, and adjust in real time for weather, breakdowns, and customer changes.
* Track every truck and load, including location, status, hours, tonnage, and on-time performance.

* Represent Sterling Multi-Chem professionally with customers or field office personnel, meeting commitments while responding promptly to customer needs.

* 1+ year of driving experience in the oilfield
