**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them.
  
  
The Director, Software Delivery and Business Operations ensures the organization has the measurements to hit its commitments, run execution through the daily, weekly, and monthly business reviews, and clear what blocks it. Your team owns the handovers between teams and organizations, the integrated schedule, and the consistent use of one toolchain and one system of record across every team. You will improve and evolve the tools and processes the organization runs on: task tracking, change control management (CCM), and reporting, building on what teams use today. You then keep status transparent in real time, so anyone can see where every team, commitment, and change stands without asking.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Improve and evolve the tools and processes  

* Improve task tracking for every team: one backlog standard, shared definitions of ready and done, and cross-team dependencies tracked as work items with a named giver and receiver.
* Evolve change control management: the change control board, the process for changes to requirements, interfaces, timing, resources, and schedule, and the records that make impact analysis automatic.
* Improve reporting: live dashboards and business-review content generated from the systems of record, built with DevOps.
* Maintain real-time transparency on status as the tools evolve: keep the data current, close gaps in adoption, and make status visible to every team and leader without manual reporting.

  
Execution and handovers  

* Own every handover between teams and organizations: a named giver and receiver, exit criteria, and recorded acceptance.
* Own the integrated schedule, the critical path, and the risk and commitment registers. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on.
* Run one backlog standard, a common sprint calendar, and regular cross-team planning sessions where teams commit the dependencies they give and receive.
* Ensure consistent tools and consistent use across all teams, so performance and efficiency can be measured and compared.

Automation  

* Run the business-review system on live dashboards, with status derived from the systems of record rather than reported.
* Automate dependency, risk, and impact analysis on the digital thread (the linked chain from requirement to code, test, and release).
* Work with DevOps as the owning customer for dashboards and workflow automation.

  
Change, suppliers, and incidents  

* Operate the change control board and requirements traceability, so impact analysis is derived, not assembled.
* Own supplier and mobile network operator (MNO) program relationships, milestones, and consequence management.
* Give the program-ready sign-off alongside the other release sign-offs, and run incident command from lab defect to on-orbit anomaly.
* Run the lab program and the transition into operations, and baseline the software milestones in the integrated schedule against the manufacturing readiness gate.

  
Leadership  

* Own the multi-year vision, roadmap, and operating plan for the function, and set the investment case for what to automate next.
* Hire, develop, and retain managers, principal engineers, and senior technical leaders; differentiate performance and build a succession plan for your role and every critical role.
* Influence decisions at Vice President level with data and written narratives, and be the decision maker for escalations in your area.
* Build durable mechanisms that raise the bar, remove manual work and bureaucracy, and keep workloads sustainable while the organization scales.
* Own the budget, compliance, and safety obligations for the function, and decide where to invest and where not to.
* Run talent reviews and onboarding standards, grow leaders of leaders, and build an organization that sustains itself without you.

  
About the team  
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Operations & Technical Program Management; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. About Ark
  
  
Ark is a digital infrastructure platform operating data center and cloud infrastructure for organizations with critical and changing demands. Operating since 2007, Ark delivers owned-and-operated data centers designed around customer requirements, with direct control over cost and configuration. Resource-efficient designs, advanced cooling and carrier-neutral connectivity support enterprise, AI and other workloads from low to ultra-high density.
  
  
The role
  
  
Our clients count on Ark for reliable, well-run service, and this role makes sure that happens. As Manager, Service Management & Client Operations, you will support Ark's IT service management (ITSM) processes end to end for a set of assigned clients: Case, Request, Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management. You will be the main escalation point between assigned clients and our internal support teams.
  
  
You will also help our Service Delivery Center (SDC) take on more. You'll find work the SDC can handle for other teams, set up the hand-off, and make sure the SDC team is trained and ready. You'll work closely with the Director of Client Services and Service Delivery Center Manager as a trusted partner on priorities and initiatives across the client service function.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Service management for assigned clients
  
  

* Follow Ark's Case, Request, Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for assigned clients, and give feedback to improve them in line with ITIL best practices.
* Identify and recommend improvements including automation and workflow improvements, to increase efficiency and client satisfaction.
* Support the Major Incident response process for assigned clients from identification through resolution, including coordination, client and internal communication, and post-incident reviews (PIRs) with tracked corrective actions.
* Create, review, and approve change requests for assigned clients, and represent those clients at Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, risk and rollback review, scheduling, communication, and change success-rate reporting.
* Own Problem Management for assigned clients. Lead root cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents, and maintain problem records, known errors, workarounds, and permanent fixes.

Serve our clients
  
  

* Act as the escalation point between a set of assigned clients and internal teams. Communicate priorities, expectations, and status, and support complex or non-standard requests.
* Monitor queues and escalations for quality and timeliness for assigned clients. Track service level agreement (SLA) performance and raise risks early.
* Report on defined SLAs and service metrics (such as mean time to resolve, backlog, reopen rate, and change success rate) to Ark leadership and clients.

Expand what the SDC can do
  
  

* Analyze ticket trends and workloads for assigned clients to identify tier-1 and tier-2 work the SDC can take on for other teams.
* Serve as a liaison between internal teams and the SDC, setting hand-off criteria, expectations, and escalation paths in partnership with SDC Manager.
* Partner with subject matter experts to build runbooks and knowledge base articles (KBAs), train SDC staff, and confirm readiness before work transitions.
* Measure results after each transition (quality, turnaround time, ticket deflection) and adjust.

Build knowledge and develop people
  
  

* Create and maintain KBAs, runbooks, and client-specific documentation for assigned clients, following Ark’s documentation standards. Coach and mentor future service coordinators.
* Partner with Client Services, Service Delivery Center, Engineering, Product, and Support leadership on process alignment.
* Work with the Director of Client Services on strategy and priorities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and represent the Director with clients and internal leaders as needed.

**Requirements**
What you bring
  
  

* 5+ years in IT service management, service delivery, or IT operations, including at least 2 years in a lead or management role.
* Hands-on ownership of Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management in a client-facing data center, managed services, or large enterprise environment.
* Experience building SOPs, knowledge base content, and training for support teams.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or the ability to earn it within 6 months of hire.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including calm, clear leadership during high-pressure incidents.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot trends and turn them into improvements.
* Ability to build relationships and influence across teams without direct authority.

Nice to have
  
  

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience moving work into a shared service or support center.
* Lean or Six Sigma experience.
* SaaS or healthcare IT experience.

Schedule and travel
  
  

* This role leads Major Incident response and requires some after-hours and weekend availability.
* Occasional travel to Ark sites and client locations.

* Hold the team to disciplined Salesforce hygiene, including partner attribution, account categorization, and deal registration.

*Partner Programs and Enablement*

* Ensure each GSI has a joint business plan, named target accounts, executive sponsors, and quarterly milestones.

* Experience with Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud co-sell and marketplace motions.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC and partner-led deal registration processes.

The Security Technologies crypto team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer who is a technical leader, creative and committed to delivering quality software. This role is Hybrid in Raleigh NC, Boston MA or Lowell MA.
  
  
Our team is focused on cryptographic back-end components such as OpenSSL, GnuTLS and Network Security Services as well as cryptographic protocols like TLS, SSH and IPSEC. As a Senior Software Engineer, your main focus will be on designing, developing, testing and collaborating with other contributors over the world to bring features on existing components. This is an ideal position for engineers interested in contributing to open source projects, and developing cryptographic software to be used by millions of users and applications. This position is intended to be specially focused on the area around Smart Cards and their integration in the operating system. Smart cards are personal hardware (physical) cryptographic modules for storing cryptographic keys and for handling operations using them securely. As a Senior Software Engineer, your main focus will be on assisting the design, development, testing to bring features on existing smart card drivers in OpenSC project as well as implementing and testing future generations of Post Quantum Cryptography capable Smart Cards.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead the design and development of software solutions for a Smart Cards subsystem, own the quality of their code and contribute to testing frameworks.
* Participate in the whole development cycle from requirements gathering, scoping, source code development to testing and verification
* Design and implement new features in cryptographic back-ends
* Improve and simplify crypto libraries API to reduce misuse
* Actively contribute to Fedora and Red Hat Enterprise Linux development
* Communicate and collaborate with developers and teams inside and outside Red Hat
* Influence the technical direction of their team and adjacent teams by building consensus in broader discussions with internal customers or through active participation in external communities
* Mentor and coach other engineers, share expertise by producing comprehensive design documents, writing blog posts, and mentoring others on documentation and communication best practices

What you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a primary focus on cryptography
* Ability to work Hybrid in Boston MA, Lowell MA or Raleigh NC.
* C / Rust programming experience; professional or academic experience is required
* Knowledge of Linux operating system and its development tools; any distribution is OK
* Academic or engineering background in security engineering or cryptography
* Familiarity with TLS/SSL, IPSec/IKE or SSH protocol.
* Knowledge of PKCS#11 or PKIX technologies
* Familiarity with the use of crypto libraries like OpenSSL, GnuTLS or NSS
* Knowledge and proven experience in crypto algorithm or protocol implementations

**The Following Will Be Considered a Plus**

* Demonstrated ability to join open source projects and contribute
* Knowledge of Python
* Experience and passion in regards the AI-assisted development

The Red Hat Hybrid Platforms Product Management team is looking for a Principal Product Manager (technical) to own and drive identity solutions in Red Hat OpenShift.

In this role, you are responsible for how people, workloads, and software agents authenticate to OpenShift and how OpenShift decides what they are allowed to do. You will work with the Engineering and Product teams who build and deliver those capabilities. The product area includes:

* User authentication and authorization, including the OpenShift OAuth server and external OpenID Connect integrations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity, multi-cluster authentication on OpenShift clusters
* Identity and user federation to secure agentic workflows in OpenShift.

You will contribute to company strategy and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Support, Sales, Security, and Field teams.

You will engage with the open source communities behind this work, including Kubernetes and other Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.

As a Principal Product Manager, you need great communication, teamwork, and persuasion skills to articulate the product vision, align teams across the company, and influence stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work on a core platform control alongside some of the brightest minds in open source.

---------------------

* Collect input from OpenShift users, customers, community members, and internal stakeholders on how enterprises manage identity, and turn that input into strategy and a roadmap
* Define the product vision, the customer problems to solve, and measurable outcomes for authentication, authorization, and workload identity.
* Define and use metrics for adoption and measuring success
* Research commercial and do-it-yourself alternatives and use that research for competitive positioning
* Prioritize and document requirements, epics, and user stories, with acceptance criteria, for new releases
* Guide major enhancements with OpenShift Engineering, Kubernetes upstream, and adjacent product teams.
* Drive the identity model that agentic features in OpenShift and related products use, and work with those product teams so agents obtain authority through OpenShift identity and authorization
* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.
* Support go-to-market work, including presentations, blogs, demos, workshops, events, and sales enablement, and review documentation for this area
* Keep Engineering, Support, and Field aligned on direction, and own the translation of strategy into a release plan

------------------------

* A track record of leading cross-functional work on a platform, security, or identity management, and of influencing people who do not report to you
* Direct experience with Kubernetes identity management.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and or how enterprises use identity provider (e.g. Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Federate).

* Working knowledge of the CNCF ecosystem and experience with open source projects

* Experience with SPIFFE and SPIRE, LDAP, or Active Directory

* Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to align priorities, implement changes, and improve business processes.

* Familiarity with marketing operations technology, reporting and data analysis, workflow automation, and AI productivity tools.

Meet the Team
  
  
At Cisco Meraki, we believe that simplifying powerful technology can change the world. The Meraki Dashboard is the industry-leading, cloud-managed single pane of glass used by millions of IT administrators worldwide to manage mission-critical networking, smart cameras, cellular gateways, and security infrastructure. As an Engineering Manager for the Frontend Platform, you will lead the core engineering team responsible for the foundational UI architecture, design systems, and developer experience across the Meraki Dashboard. You will guide a team of engineers building and scaling Meraki’s design system and shared React component libraries, support our modern React and TypeScript Micro-Frontend (MFE) ecosystem, and partner with product engineering teams across Meraki to ensure our web applications are fast, accessible, consistent, and a joy to build.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Support engineers through dedicated 1-on-1s, structured career development plans, mentorship, and continuous feedback to cultivate an inclusive, high-trust, and collaborative environment.
* Guide sprint ceremonies, quarterly roadmap planning, and delivery execution while maintaining a sustainable pace and high engineering craftsmanship.
* Partner closely with UX Design, Product leads, and Backend/API Platform leads to govern, evolve, and expand our enterprise Design System and React UI component libraries across all feature teams.
* Guide technical strategy around React, TypeScript, CSS/Design Tokens, and modern Micro-Frontend (MFE) architectures using Webpack Module Federation.
* Improve developer workflows by reducing friction in local development, enhancing monorepo tooling (such as Nx/Yarn), accelerating CI/CD pipelines, and advocating for web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) best practices.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Experience directly managing software engineers or substantial experience as a technical lead with a proven track record of mentorship, team guidance, and technical execution.
* Experience in modern frontend development, specifically JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, and CSS/Design Tokens.
* Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or scaling enterprise Design Systems and reusable React component libraries.
* Understanding of frontend architectures, modular web applications, state management patterns, and asset pipeline optimization.
* Ability to articulate architectural trade-offs and complex technical decisions clearly to engineers, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Hands-on experience with Micro-Frontend (MFE) architectures and Webpack Module Federation in large-scale applications.
* Experience with monorepo tooling (e.g., Nx, Turborepo) and CI/CD asset pipeline optimization.
* Deep knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and accessible component design best practices.
* A genuine passion for improving developer workflows, accelerating feedback loops, and eliminating developer toil.
* Experience defining and tracking measurable service-level objectives (SLOs) around design system adoption, frontend performance, and developer velocity.

As an Engineering Product Manager within the GSO Market Access Program, you own Cisco product management for offers delivered into the AWS TS region. You are the accountable extension Cisco Business Unit (BU) product and project managers and our end customers, and your job is to close the gap between what customers expect and what the BU actually delivers. You translate mission requirements, compliance and authorization obligations, and customer commitments into clear product requirements, priorities, and delivery plans, then drive them through the BU and GSO engineering teams to production.
  
This is an individual contributor role. The leadership it requires is product and technical leadership: setting product direction for the TS region, crafting BU roadmaps through influence and evidence, and driving standard processes across Cisco’s DoD and Government Solutions efforts, rather than formal people management.
  
  
Who You’ll Work With
  
  
You will partner directly with the GSO Principal Architect within the Security& Trust Organization’s Government Solutions (GSO) team, and work day to day with Cisco BU product and project managers and with customer program and mission partners. The role cuts across software development, platform and SRE, IaaS, SecOps, incident command, compliance and authorization, and the broader Cisco security portfolio.
  
GSO’s vision is to be the leader in delivering Cisco SaaS offers to the US Federal market, while attracting and developing top talent for an innovative engineering team. GSO drives this through a dynamic multi-functional team that collaborates in an agile setting and values every individual’s contribution.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
You are a product manager who came up through hands-on engineering, not around it. You are comfortable turning an authorization boundary, a network topology, or a security control requirement into a clear, testable product requirement. We are looking for an incredible technology solutions manager to help the T-Mobile for Business & Government proposal team win more business with smarter technology. If you love turning a business need into a solution that works, and you get excited about putting AI and automation to work on real, high-stakes problems, this is your role.  
  
You will lead the technical strategy for how our proposal team works. You will start at the beginning: leading scoping conversations, defining business requirements and technical scope, and deciding what is feasible. Then you will set the vision, design the solution and serve as the technical owner who sees it through to deployment. You will partner with business and technology teams, including T-Mobile's central AI team, IT Security and Procurement, to prioritize and deliver complete, concise solutions that fit our business priorities and technical standards.  
  
The world of proposals is changing fast. Buyers now use AI to screen, summarize and score responses, so our tools have to be at least as capable as theirs. You will help us get there. You will own our proposal automation tools and AI-enabled workflows, gather requirements from our team, test what gets built, shape the user experience and train our people to use it. You will also help us choose and manage the right vendors. You will see the results quickly, in time saved, quality gained and business won.  
  
Our team thrives on testing new ideas, building new processes and rethinking how proposals get done. Your ideas will be heard, and you will help shape the future of proposals at T-Mobile.

**Who you are:**

* You love taking a messy business problem and turning it into a clear technical plan.
* You are as comfortable in a requirements workshop as you are testing a new tool.
* You are curious about AI and automation, and you want to put them to work, not just talk about them.
* You don't just take orders. You are a great collaborator and a natural leader.
* You influence stakeholders at every level and keep projects moving.
* You think strategically, but you stay accountable for the details and for getting it deployed.
* You are humble and fearless, and you enjoy working independently.
* You are excited to help define what proposal technology looks like next.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the start of every initiative: define business requirements and technical scope so projects begin with a clear foundation.
* Develop and communicate technology strategies and solution designs that guide what we prioritize and how we deliver.
* Serve as the technical owner, with stewardship and accountability for business deployment initiatives from design through rollout.
* Lead analysis, design and project management so technology solutions work inside our business processes.
* Own our proposal automation tools and AI-enabled workflows, and partner with T-Mobile's central AI team on requirements, testing and the user experience.
* Help keep our AI use safe, governed and measurable, working with IT Security.
* Partner with Procurement on vendor needs, evaluations and vendor relationships.
* Train and enable the team to get real results from new tools, and measure the impact.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States
* A bachelor's degree plus 5 years of related experience, or an advanced degree plus 3 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 4 to 7 years of related experience
* Experience leading scoping, requirements and technical delivery for business initiatives

**Nice to have:**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
* Experience with proposal automation or RFx platforms and Salesforce
* Experience with AI tools, workflow automation or integrations
* Experience supporting vendor evaluations with a procurement team
* APMP Foundation certification, or the willingness to earn it

The Sr. Partner Business Manager is a revenue-driving role that owns T-Mobile's executive-level relationship with one or two national Technology Services Distributors (TSDs), serving as the strategic bridge between senior partner leadership and T-Mobile's regional and inside channel teams to accelerate revenue through the partnership. This person leads joint business planning built around clear revenue targets, negotiates and manages contracts that protect and grow T-Mobile's position, and carries full accountability for revenue growth generated through the partnership. Success requires a proactive, relationship-driven operator who can navigate complex partner organizations, speak credibly to executives, and create and launch strategic initiatives that translate directly into incremental bookings, all while consistently earning T-Mobile's seat at the table. The role's results directly shape T-Mobile's share of revenue sourced through its national TSD partnerships and the terms under which TSD-affiliated Technology Advisors sell T-Mobile.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Executive Relationship & Revenue Ownership: Serve as the primary executive-level point of contact for one or two assigned Technology Services Distributors (TSDs), using that relationship to unlock and accelerate revenue growth across the partnership. Develop and drive joint annual and quarterly business plans with the TSD, aligning goals, growth targets, and investment priorities. Own and report on revenue performance sourced through the partnership.
* Strategic Initiatives: Conceive, build, and execute go-to-market strategies and strategic initiatives with the TSD(s) that expand T-Mobile's share of TSD revenue, optimizing offers, programs, and investment to meet growth targets.
* National Presence: Represent T-Mobile at national TSD events, partner summits, and training and certification programs. Translate TSD and market intelligence into recommendations for T-Mobile leadership and cross-functional teams on offers, programs, and investment.
* Advisor Access: Build and protect senior relationships within the TSD to secure consistent, high-quality introductions to Technology Advisors (TAs).
* Marketing & MDF: Partner with channel marketing on co-branded programs, MDF strategy, and event sponsorship for the assigned TSD(s).
* Org Navigation: Understand the TSD's organizational structure well enough to help field-based Partner Account Managers (PAMs) navigate it effectively, with the goal of securing high-quality introductions to regional TAs.
* Contract Management: Own contract negotiation, renewal, and compliance with the assigned TSD(s), ensuring terms support the partnership's revenue and growth objectives and protect T-Mobile's interests.

**Education:**
--------------

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent (Required)

**Required Experience:**
------------------------

* 7+ years of channel sales, partner management, or strategic alliances experience within telecom, IT, or SaaS, including direct work with TSDs/master agents
* 7+ years of executive-level relationship management, with a track record of building credibility and influence with senior partner leadership
* 7+ years of contract negotiation and management experience, including structuring agreements that drive measurable revenue outcomes
* 7+ years of direct accountability for revenue growth or quota attainment, ideally through a partner or channel relationship
* 7+ years of joint business planning experience, developing and executing strategic initiatives with partner organizations that translate into incremental bookings

**Preferred Experience:**
-------------------------

* Marketing Fluency: Understands the sales funnel and how co-marketing, MDF, and event strategy translate into pipeline

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Executive Communication: Comfortable presenting and building trust with senior leadership at the partner organization.
* Financial Acumen: Working knowledge of finance and deal economics, well enough to speak credibly to business planning and investment tradeoffs.
* Business Development: Able to spot and build new angles of strategic growth within the partnership rather than just maintaining what exists, and orchestrates sales and growth plays for all offerings relevant to the TSD channel.
* Negotiation: Skilled at contract discussions and renewal terms that control costs while keeping the partner motivated.
* Relationship Management: Builds durable trust with partner executives over time, including through inevitable friction points.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Effective in coordinating across internal teams and partner organizations.
* Sales Operations: Understands funnel, forecasting, and CRM standards.
* GTM Knowledge: Experience with the TSD channel and the financial and enablement models that support it (commissions, SPIFFs, etc.). Understands the spectrum of TA business models (MSP, VAR, agent, etc.).
* Cross-Functional Experience: Experience working across enterprise sales, channel sales, marketing, partner management, and executive leadership.
* Sales Objectives: Clearly establishes and manages to sales targets.
* Sales Delivery: Can position a value proposition to a partner that results in activation of that partner and revenue to T-Mobile.
* Strategic Planning: Builds multi-quarter joint business and go-to-market plans that tie partner investment to revenue targets.
* Sales Leadership: Aligns and influences regional and inside channel teams, without direct authority, toward shared partnership revenue goals.

----------------------------

* Travel: Frequent local and domestic travel, including overnight stays
* Valid driver's license required

The Sr Manager, Forward Deployment Engineer leads the FDE management layer within T-Mobile's AI Center of Excellence Agentic Automation Practice. Identify resourcing imbalances, coordinate with BU leaders and the Sr Director, and ensure each pod has the right mix of experience levels. Manage headcount planning and hiring pipeline for the FDE practice.
* Senior BU Relationship Management: Serve as the senior FDE practice point of contact for BU leadership at the Director and VP level. Escalate structural delivery blockers, negotiate domain prioritization, and align the FDE practice roadmap with BU strategic objectives. Represent FDE validated ROI outcomes in cross-functional senior leadership forums.
* Practice Health & Delivery Standards: Own practice-level metrics including aggregate ROI performance across pods, FDE retention, domain assignment health, and delivery quality. Set and enforce responsible AI, data security, and privacy standards across all FDE deliverables. Partner with TPMs and CoE leadership to ensure requirements intake and delivery handoffs are operating effectively.

* Bachelor's Degree Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field. Master's Degree preferred. Relevant equivalent experience accepted. (Required)
* 7-10 years Total experience in technical and people leadership roles combined, including 5+ years of progressive people management experience with demonstrated ability to manage other managers or senior technical leads. Hands-on production engineering foundation required. Track record of leading technical teams to measurable business outcomes in ambiguous delivery environments. (Required)
* More than 10 years Candidates with 10+ years of combined technical and leadership experience preferred. Ideal background includes having built or scaled a forward deployment, solutions engineering, or embedded technical practice, and experience managing multi-domain programs with rotating team or project structures. * Management of Managers: Demonstrated experience managing other people managers: coaching manager effectiveness, diagnosing team health through an indirect layer, and holding managers accountable for their teams' outcomes. (Required)

The Sr. Partner Sales Executive (SPSE) is a revenue-driving role focused on growing T-Mobile's business through named Technology Advisors (TAs). The SPSE is accountable for a portfolio of 75+ TAs and owns an assigned annual revenue quota that contributes to the channel's multimillion-dollar annual target. The SPSE owns the performance of an assigned TA portfolio by setting portfolio strategy and executing business plans specifically engineered to accelerate revenue, arming TAs with T-Mobile market insights and proven demand-gen strategies that convert into closed bookings, and clearing internal friction points that slow down the sales cycle by influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority. As the internal advocate for TAs, the SPSE ensures nothing stands between a TA and a signed deal. The SPSE is also responsible for expanding the revenue base itself by proactively identifying and activating new TAs to fill territory gaps and add incremental production to the book.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Revenue Delivery & Partner Growth: Own and deliver the portfolio's annual revenue target. Partner with priority TAs on a short, joint plan tied to a shared value proposition, then drive that plan into the field by activating TAs on live opportunities, removing obstacles to close, and focusing training, resources, and MDF where expected return is highest.
* Activate New Agents: Sell the value of a T-Mobile partnership to agents not currently doing business with T-Mobile, with the goal of converting them into producing partners. Identify and prospect targets, manage them through a defined pipeline from first outreach to signed agreement and first closed deal, and own new-agent activation and first-year production goals. Build the new-agent pipeline proactively, using Technology Services Distributor (TSD) relationships, market intelligence, and territory gaps, to add incremental revenue and meet or exceed portfolio revenue targets.
* Activity Management & Participation: Drive increased partner engagement across the 75+ TA portfolio by growing the number of partners actively participating in open opportunities. Track partner activity and participation rates, identify dormant or under-engaged TAs, and execute targeted re-engagement plans to convert inactive partners into active pipeline contributors.
* Revenue Growth & Performance Monitoring: Monitor TA performance against set goals and KPIs. Provide regular feedback and coaching to TAs to enhance their productivity and sales capabilities.
* Pipeline & Forecast Management: Manage and optimize the sales pipeline for new and renewal business to ensure accurate forecasting of indirect business. Support TAs in building and managing their sales pipeline efficiently.
* Partner Segmentation & Territory Planning: Segment the 75+ TA portfolio to identify MVP and high-potential TAs and set a territory management plan that drives efficiency and revenue, determining which TAs receive priority investment and where coverage gaps call for new-agent activation.
* Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis: Gather and analyze market trends and competitive dynamics to inform portfolio strategy and provide TAs with actionable intelligence. Share insights to help them adjust strategies and remain competitive, and escalate channel-level insights that can shape T-Mobile's indirect programs, incentives, or offers.
* Advocate for TAs: Serve as the primary point of contact, senior escalation point, and advocate for TAs within T-Mobile. Resolve cross-functional blockers through influence rather than authority, and drive systemic fixes to recurring process or policy friction rather than case-by-case workarounds. Build and maintain relationships with TSD leadership to align priorities and joint plans for the TA portfolio.

The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred

The Marketing Operations Manager is responsible for the operational execution, governance, reporting, and optimization of marketing-generated leads and campaigns across Rogers Business. This role serves as a subject matter expert for Salesforce, lead management processes, campaign execution, reporting and analytics, and data governance.
  
  
Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Product, Digital, and Technology teams, the incumbent ensures that campaigns are successfully launched, leads are accurately managed and routed, reporting is reliable, and business stakeholders receive actionable insights to support revenue growth.
  
  
This position plays a critical role in supporting growth initiatives across Enterprise, SMB, Dealer/Partner, Retail, Digital, and Base programs while driving continuous improvement of lead management platforms, processes, and reporting capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Operations & Execution**

* Manage end-to-end campaign operations for marketing and sales programs.
* Support campaign intake, requirements gathering, prioritization, and execution planning.
* Coordinate campaign launches across multiple channels and business units.
* Ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on time.
* Support major revenue-generating initiatives including acquisition, upsell, cross-sell, retention, migration, serviceability, and partner programs.

**Salesforce Administration & Lead Management**

* Act as the business lead and subject matter expert for Lead Management within Salesforce.
* Maintain campaign structures, lead routing rules, ownership processes, and automation workflows.
* Design and implement process improvements that improve reporting accuracy and sales execution.
* Manage lead ownership governance.
* Support Salesforce enhancements, releases, testing, and adoption initiatives.
* Work closely with Sales Operations and Technology teams to improve CRM functionality and user experience.

**Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Establish and maintain standards for lead quality, campaign attribution, and Salesforce data integrity.
* Conduct data validation, cleansing, segmentation, and campaign readiness reviews.
* Manage lead distribution and assignment processes across multiple sales organizations.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues impacting campaign execution and reporting.

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to build scalable solutions using Salesforce, Power Automate, Revenue.io, and related technologies.
* Support business transformation initiatives focused on improving campaign execution efficiency.
* Document processes, create operating procedures, and maintain operational standards.

**Stakeholder Management & Enablement**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Technology, and Sales Operations teams.
* Train and support users on lead management processes, Salesforce functionality, and reporting tools.
* Influence business decisions through data-driven recommendations and operational expertise.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 5+ years experience in Marketing Operations, CRM Operations, Sales Operations, Lead Management, or Business Analytics.
* Experience supporting national sales and marketing organizations.
* Experience managing complex campaigns within Salesforce environments.
* Experience developing business reporting and dashboard solutions.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Salesforce CRM knowledge.
* Strong understanding of lead lifecycle management and campaign attribution.
* Power BI reporting and dashboard development.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Marketing automation platform experience.
* Process automation experience (Power Automate, workflow tools, CRM automations).

**Key Success Metrics**

* Campaign launches delivered on time.
* Lead volume and quality targets achieved.
* Salesforce data quality and compliance standards maintained.
* Campaign conversion and opportunity creation performance.
* Reporting accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Reduction in manual processes through automation.
* Revenue contribution from supported campaigns.

The Payroll Manager is responsible for leading national payroll operations, strategy, and compliance for over 25,000 employees across Canada. This role oversees the accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of multi-province biweekly and monthly payrolls, manages payroll system enhancements, and leads a dedicated team of payroll professionals. The Payroll Manager serves as a technical subject matter expert and trusted advisor to People & Culture, Finance, and executive leadership, ensuring alignment with federal and provincial regulations, risk & compliance, and corporate objectives.
  
  
****What you'll do****
**Payroll Operations & Execution**

* Lead and oversee full-cycle biweekly and monthly payroll processing for 25,000 salaried and hourly team members across all Canadian provinces and territories
* Ensure 100% accuracy and timeliness of payroll calculations, deductions, garnishments, taxable benefits, and expense reimbursements
* Manage payroll financial processes, including general ledger postings, journal entries, payroll accruals, account reconciliations, and wire transfers
* Oversee year-end processing, including T4/T4A and RL-1 preparation, filing, and distribution, as well as PIER report resolutions

**Compliance, Audit & Risk Management**

* Ensure strict adherence to Canadian federal and provincial employment standards, tax legislation, Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) guidelines, and Revenu Québec (MRQ) regulations
* Maintain and enforce robust internal controls to comply with corporate governance and audit requirements
* Serve as the primary liaison for internal, external, and government regulatory audits, preparing required documentation and reports
* Monitor evolving payroll laws and regulations across Canada, proactively implementing required process or system updates

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Provide direct leadership, mentoring, and performance management for a team of payroll specialists and advisors
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, service excellence, and cross-functional collaboration within the payroll team
* Establish operational KPIs and benchmarks to monitor payroll accuracy, inquiry response times, and processing efficiency

**Systems, Strategy & Process Optimization**

* Drive continuous process improvement and automation initiatives to simplify payroll workflows and enhance data integrity
* Serve as the functional/business lead for enterprise payroll software and HRIS modules (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors / ECP / SAP Payroll)
* Partner with IT, HR Operations, and Finance teams to test, configure, and implement payroll system upgrades, interfaces, and tools

**Stakeholder Partnership & Advisory**

* Act as the primary technical resource and advisor on complex payroll matters for P & C Business Partners, Finance, Total Rewards, and Legal
* Manage escalated payroll inquiries and complex compensation scenarios with high confidentiality, discretion, and customer focus
* Oversee relationships with third-party payroll vendors, benefit carriers, and tax authorities

**What You'll Bring**
**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 7–10+ years of progressive payroll management experience in large-scale, multi-province Canadian organizations supporting 20,000+ employees
* System Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with enterprise HRIS/payroll systems (SAP Payroll / SAP SuccessFactors ECP highly preferred) and advanced MS Excel capabilities
* Regulatory Knowledge: Thorough understanding of Canadian federal/provincial payroll legislation, CRA, Revenu Québec, statutory remittances, and audit frameworks
* Labor Environment: Experience managing payroll within both unionized and non-unionized operating environments
* Leadership: Proven track record of leading, coaching, and developing high-performing payroll operations teams

**Required Education & Professional Designations**

* Payroll Certification: Certified Payroll Manager (CPM) designation from the National Payroll Institute (NPI) required; Payroll Compliance Professional (PCP) designation considered
* Accounting / Finance Designation: CPA designation or post-secondary degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or Business Administration preferred

**Core Competencies & Skills**

* High degree of analytical thinking, detail orientation, and quantitative problem-solving skills
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex financial data to non-finance stakeholders
* Strong change management skills with comfort operating in fast-paced, evolving corporate environments
* Bilingualism in English and French (oral and written) is considered a strong asset

Advanced knowledge of English is required because you will most of the time interact in English with external parties (clients, suppliers, candidates, external partners, etc.); interact in English with internal parties (colleagues, internal partners, stakeholders, etc.) as part of this position's main responsibilities given its national scope.
